post.title: Brazil's Stock Fund Fell 19.8% in One Day. Here's Why.
post.ig:
One country's stock fund lost nearly 20% in one day.
The iShares MSCI Brazil ETF (EWZ) closed down 19.8% on Oct 26, 2026, its second-worst day since 2000.
The Bovespa closed down 13.9%, its biggest drop since March 2020, and the real lost 8.1% vs the dollar.
It followed Lula's runoff win with 51.8% of the vote. The S&P 500 rose 0.7% the same day.
Sources: Yahoo Finance, Motley Fool, The Rio Times, The Globe and Mail, AP, MSCI.
